name: ringringring
displayName: ringringring — your agent calls your phone, no Docker
description: Two-way voice calls from Claude Code to your phone over free SIP (Linphone). Native build: prebuilt pjsua2, no Docker. Ears (STT) and mouth (TTS) are swappable: any OpenAI-compatible transcription endpoint, any TTS command.

sip_id.title: Your SIP address
sip_id.description: e.g. sip:you@sip.linphone.org. Also the number that gets called unless you set one below. Leave blank to use ~/.config/ringringring/voice.env instead.

sip_pass.title: SIP password
sip_pass.description: Stored in your OS keychain, never in a file.

sip_callee.title: Address to call (optional)
sip_callee.description: Leave blank to call your own SIP address.

display_name.title: Caller-ID name (optional)
display_name.description: Name shown on your phone when the agent calls.

stt_api_key.title: Speech-to-text API key
stt_api_key.description: Key for the transcription endpoint below (Groq by default).

stt_lang.title: Spoken language
stt_lang.description: Language hint for transcription, e.g. zh or en.

tts_voice.title: Edge TTS voice
tts_voice.description: Used by the default mouth (edge-tts). Ignored if VOICE_TTS_CMD is set in voice.env.

stun_server.title: STUN server
stun_server.description: Lets the phone's audio find its way back through NAT. The default works for most setups.

end_silence.title: Seconds of silence that end your turn
end_silence.description: How long you can pause before your turn counts as finished.
